Izzy: Heads-up: CS flagged a tenant seeing v1 responses despite `x-api-version: 2` headers. No console hint, no banner. Customer upset.
Tom: Which tenant/time? Any root-cause in logs?
Izzy: tenant-508, 03:12-03:20 UTC. Logs show `routed_version=1` and `fallback_reason=capacity` repeatedly. Billing shows v1 rates.
metric-bot: spike: implicit_route_switch{tenant="tenant-508",route="/chat"} +86 in 8m.
Asha: Oof. Two problems: (1) customers are unaware, (2) invoices don't match perceived behavior. We need telemetry + a lightweight console signal.
Tom: Agree. Proposal: emit `version_routing_event` with labels tenant, route, incoming_version, routed_version, reason. Add `routed_version` to billing annotation for invoice windows.
Izzy: Console UX: not a full deprecation banner. Add a per-route "parity pill" showing percent of requests honoring requested version. Click -> drilldown table with recent requests.
Ben: Telemetry note: cardinality concern if we index by route+model+tenant. Suggest tenant-level aggregates for the pill and optional per-route sampling for drilldown.
Asha: For alerts, start probe-mode. Prom sketch: `sum by (tenant) (increase(implicit_route_switch[10m])) > 10 and increase(implicit_route_switch[10m]) > 2 * median_over_time(increase(implicit_route_switch[10m])[7d:1m])`. Combine with `increase(header_version_mismatch[10m]) > 4` to reduce false positives.
Tom: UX states: gray (>=98% parity), amber (probe), orange (investigate), red (sustained >30m). Badge tooltip: "Routing parity: 82% — 12 fallbacks in last 10m".
Izzy: Ops asks: when probe alert fires include remediation hints: link to autoscaler events, last deploys, and quick pin command example: `redwood admin pin-route --tenant tenant-508 --route /chat --version v2 --duration 30m`.
Ben: Implement metrics: 1) `version_routing_event` raw stream 2) `stability_score` (decay-weighted fallbacks) 3) `current_version_ratio` aggregated per-tenant. We'll keep per-route samples for drilldowns.
Asha: Also emit audit event `silent_downgrade` when tenant >20 downgrades in 10m. Include up to 50 sample trace links for CS triage.
Tom: Could we add a semantic weight per-route (embeddings=10, rerank=5, chat=1) so alerts prioritize high-risk endpoints?
Izzy: Yes — embeddings fallbacks should be elevated automatically. For embeddings we should trigger an automated eval job (opt-in) that compares downgraded outputs against a small seed set and notifies CS if delta exceeds threshold. Respect opt-out and privacy rules.
metric-bot: action: queued eval job "embeddings_regression_check" (tenant opt-in required).
Ben: Plan: 1) define `version_routing_event` schema 2) add `stability_score` and `current_version_ratio` derived metrics 3) build parity pill + drilldown UI 4) add probe-mode alert rules for 48-72h 5) emit audit events + billing annotation 6) iterate thresholds after data.
Asha: Owners: Ben (metrics), Tom (alerts + graf), Izzy (CS runbook + audit events), me (console mock + UX).
Izzy: Thanks — can we aim to get the probe running by EOD so we collect a weekend baseline?
Tom: I'll draft Prom rules and a Graf panel today.
Ben: I'll wire the derived metrics; will keep cardinality protections.
metric-bot: metric `version_routing_event` proposed (dry-run).
Asha: Sync tomorrow 10:30 to review first batch of signals. :calendar:
